csv_project_name: Consultant for FY 2027 Subregional Engineering Assistance
csv_agency: North Jersey Transportation Planning Authority Inc
csv_scope_of_work: The North Jersey Transportation Planning Authority, Inc. (NJTPA) is seeking consultant support to assist member subregions under the Subregional Engineering Assistance Program (SEAP). The consultant will assist the subregions in advancing projects selected under the FY 2026 Subregional Safety Improvement Program through the federal authorization process for construction, by assisting in the preparation of plans, specifications and cost estimates. Projects include various aspects of roadway design and intersection safety improvements. Through this Request for Proposals (RFP), the NJTPA is seeking to engage four (4) firms to provide professional consultant support services on ten (10) safety improvement projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Historic Preservation, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning

title: Consultant for FY 2027 Subregional Engineering Assistance
short_description: Consultant support for roadway and intersection safety improvement design on ten subregional projects.
project_scope: Professional support for ten safety improvement projects under the FY 2026 Subregional Safety Improvement Program, advancing projects through federal authorization for construction. Scope includes preparation of plans, specifications, and cost estimates for various roadway design and intersection safety improvements. Multiple disciplines are requested, including civil, geotechnical, structural, traffic, environmental, historic preservation, and surveying/GIS.
services: Professional consultant support services for subregional engineering assistance; preparation of plans, specifications, and cost estimates; roadway design; intersection safety improvements; structural engineering; civil engineering; geotechnical engineering; traffic design engineering; environmental engineering/planning/design; surveying/GIS/mapping; historic preservation; transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Program focuses on roadway and intersection safety improvements rather than distinct bridge or special structural projects.
- Structural engineering is listed, but no specific bridge, long-span, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- This is a multi-project programmatic assignment with four firms for ten projects, reducing strategic fit.
- Scope is dominated by roadway design, traffic, environmental, and planning tasks, which are not core sbp priorities.
- No evidence of innovative structural systems, lightweight construction, sustainability focus, or notable spans.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice only mentions ten safety improvement projects involving roadway design and intersection safety improvements, with preparation of plans, specifications, and cost estimates.
fee_explanation: No consultant fee or contract value is stated in the source. Up to four contracts may be awarded for consultant support services on ten projects, but no monetary amount is provided.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines include historic preservation, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No explicit minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
